section_sequence.what_it_does: Full-screen yellow panel with a small 'DIRECT Design' wordmark before the site appears.
Black rounded pill bar inset from the edges (wordmark, 5 centered links, yellow 'Contact Us' + icon button); a black vertical 'W. Honors' tab is fixed to the right edge.

Left third: tall rounded yellow-gradient card with 3D traffic light and road signs; right: mono '/ BRAND & DESIGN AGENCY' label, big two-line grotesk H1, small justified paragraph mid-height, 'Scroll Down' cue, and a bottom-right 'DIRECT Design' badge that turns into a small 'Watch launch video' card.
The small video card grows into a near-full-width rounded black video panel (title card 'wearedirect.co') as the page scrolls.
Single row of faint grey client logos under the video.

Big 'Featured Projects' title left, '03 / SELECTED WORK' + View More right, then a 2-up grid of large project images (BoomID blue, Vital Metrics photo) with name, one-line description and mono tag chips; Scanbuilds marked 'coming soon'.
Large multi-line agency statement spanning ~2/3 width, small '02 / WHAT WE DO' paragraph and About Us button beneath.
Numbered label left, right column of large service names (Strategy open with description and, on mobile, an image; others with yellow + toggles), View Services button.
Right-column statement, then a 4-up row of mono labels over large pale 3-digit counters (005, 005, 025, 007).
Two-line H2 'Our principles in the age of AI' + short paragraph in right column, followed by a tall mostly empty area (content not rendered).
'What our clients say' H2 left with a laptop image, large pull quote right, name/role and arrow pager.
Outline says 'Let's go the Direct way' contact block; rendered as a solid black viewport in the full capture.
Yellow-to-black gradient: two big cards (white 'Prefer mail?' email, blue 'More Work'), link columns, phone/email, giant DIRECT wordmark bottom-left.

motion.observed: Yellow screen with a small 'DIRECT Design' wordmark, then the hero fades in from a yellow wash with the H1 pale before it turns solid black.
Signal lamps cycle (red '?', amber arrows, green smiley) and a green arrow moves across the 'Go the Direct Way' sign; all lamps are dark in the 0-8s intro frames and lit in later scroll frames.
The bottom-right 'DIRECT Design' badge becomes a 'Watch launch video' card by 3.5s, and its thumbnail cycles clips (laptop mock, 'Built for the moment', 'Which way?', traffic light).
The bottom-right video card scales up continuously with scroll until it spans almost the full viewport while the hero scrolls away.
'Featured Projects' starts pale grey and turns solid black as it enters the viewport (seen in mobile-scroll.jpg).
A 'Need help? Start a call' widget appears bottom-right after the video section.

The video teaser plays as a card below the hero (green 'DIRECT' graphic, 'Built for the moment when', site screenshots). Featured projects go single-column with full-width images, the Strategy accordion item shows an image, stats go 2x2, and the footer stacks the mail and More Work cards.
adaptable_ideas: Hero split with a tall rounded illustration card on one side (~1/3) and a text column that places label top, H1 near top and body copy mid-height, using vertical space as a rhythm device.
Grow a thumbnail-sized 'watch video' card into a full-width video on scroll, so the video is teased in the hero rather than taking over the first viewport.
Mono numbered section labels ('04 / WE SPECIALISE IN') in a left rail with content in the right half, repeated across every section for a consistent editorial grid.
Oversized pale counters under tiny mono captions for stats, keeping numbers visually large but low in contrast.
